concerns.text: FR‑001 (participant recruitment and pseudonymous ID assignment) is not covered by any concrete task; the only ID generation occurs in the simulated data task T003, which does not implement a real recruitment or ID‑assignment interface.

FR‑002 (web‑based administration of SART and Ospan) lacks a dedicated task. T002 only implements scoring functions; there is no task that builds or tests the web interface that delivers these tasks to participants.
FR‑003 (web‑based administration of PSS‑10 and PANAS) is absent from the task list. Scoring scripts exist (T002) but no task creates or validates the questionnaire delivery mechanism.

FR‑004 (daily compliance‑logging interface) is not represented by any task. T004 processes compliance logs after they exist, but no task specifies the creation of the self‑reporting UI or API that participants use to submit daily logs.

SC‑001 (SART significance + Cohen’s d ≥ 0.2) is not verified by any task or test; T006 performs bootstrap and Holm‑Bonferroni correction but does not assert that the resulting p‑value and effect size meet the success‑criterion thresholds.
SC‑002 (Ospan significance + Cohen’s d ≥ 0.2) suffers the same omission as SC‑001 – no task checks that the statistical output satisfies the required thresholds.
SC‑003 (PSS‑10 significance + Cohen’s d ≥ 0.2) is not covered; the pipeline produces results but no verification step ensures the success criteria are met.
SC‑004 (PANAS significance + Cohen’s d ≥ 0.2) is missing a dedicated verification task; the analysis produces numbers but does not confirm they meet the stipulated thresholds.
